jobs.title: Creative AI Video Editor
jobs.description:

The ideal candidate should have practical expertise in AI-powered content creation, image and video generation, and professional video editing, with the ability to turn creative concepts into high-quality visual content.

**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Work Arrangement:** Office-based, Dubai

**Working Schedule**

* 9 working hours per day.
* 1 weekly day off.
* Flexibility to work additional hours when required to meet production demands, project milestones, or tight deadlines.

**Key Requirements**

* Hands-on proficiency in various AI-powered creative platforms and content generation tools.
* Proven ability to create visual assets using AI image and video generation technologies.
* Strong prompt development skills, with the ability to refine instructions to achieve specific creative results.
* Solid video editing capabilities using industry-standard editing applications.
* Experience integrating AI-generated visuals, footage, and elements into professionally edited video content.
* Good understanding of visual storytelling, pacing, composition, and creative execution.
* Ability to explore emerging AI technologies, test new platforms, and incorporate effective tools into existing creative workflows.

jobs.title: Senior Creative Designer – Graphic Design, Motion Graphics & AI
jobs.description:
Senior Creative Designer – Graphic Design, Motion Graphics & AI

**Location:** Dubai, UAE  
**Salary:** AED 6,000–8,000 per month (depending on experience and capabilities)  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

About Ad&M International Advertising LLC

Ad&M International is a Dubai-based 360-degree media communication and advertising agency with over 15 years of experience in the GCC market. We specialise in media buying, advertising, public relations, digital marketing, creative production, outdoor advertising and corporate events.

We are looking for a highly creative and talented **Senior Creative Designer** to join our growing team in Dubai.

Job Overview

The ideal candidate should have a strong creative mindset, excellent design skills and the ability to independently conceptualise and execute high-quality creative work across different platforms.

We are looking for someone who can go beyond routine designing, bring fresh ideas to the table and create visually engaging campaigns that make brands stand out.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop original and visually appealing creative concepts for various client brands and campaigns.
* Design high-quality social media posts, digital advertisements, promotional materials, brochures, flyers, presentations and print advertisements.
* Create motion graphics, animated posts, promotional videos and engaging video content.
* Develop AI-powered creative visuals, advertising concepts and innovative campaign materials.
* Work on branding, campaign identities, product promotions and corporate communication materials.
* Understand client briefs and translate them into impactful visual communication.
* Stay updated with the latest creative trends, design technologies and AI tools.
* Handle multiple client projects while maintaining high standards of quality and timely delivery.
* Collaborate with the digital marketing, account management and events teams.

Required Skills & Expertise

**Essential software skills:**

* Adobe Photoshop
* Adobe Illustrator
* Adobe After Effects
* Adobe Premiere Pro

**AI and creative technology:**

* Experience with AI creative tools such as Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Runway or equivalent platforms.
* Ability to generate and enhance creative visuals using AI.
* Understanding of AI-powered video and motion content creation.

Candidate Profile

* 4–7 years of relevant professional experience preferred.
* Strong creative thinking and conceptualisation abilities.
* Excellent visual sense, typography, colour combinations and layout skills.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
* Experience working with advertising agencies or digital marketing companies will be an advantage.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet tight deadlines.
* A strong and updated creative portfolio is mandatory.

What We Expect

We are not looking for someone who simply executes design instructions. We need a creative professional who can understand a brief, think differently, suggest new ideas and consistently deliver impressive creative output.

If you are passionate about creativity, advertising, design innovation, motion graphics and AI-powered content creation, we would love to hear from you.

**Application:** Interested candidates may share their updated CV along with their creative portfolio, including graphic designs, motion graphics and AI-generated work.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: AED6,000.00 - AED8,000.00 per month

Education:

* Bachelor's (Preferred)

Experience:

* UAE: 2 years (Preferred)
* Motion Graphics: 2 years (Preferred)
* Video editing: 2 years (Preferred)
* Adobe Photoshop: 3 years (Required)
* Adobe Illustrator: 3 years (Required)
* Adobe After Effects: 3 years (Preferred)
* Adobe Premiere Pro: 3 years (Preferred)
* AI creative tools such as Midjourney, Adobe Firefly, Runway : 1 year (Preferred)
* Creating AI Generated Visuals: 2 years (Preferred)
* Advertising Agency: 4 years (Required)
* Creative Agency: 4 years (Required)

Language:

* Malayalam (Preferred)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Head of Creative Concepts – Art & Design
jobs.description:
**Head of Creative Concepts – Art & Design**

**Company:** Tashkeel – Tasmeem Tashkeel  
**Location:** Dubai, United Arab Emirates  
**Department:** Tasmeem Tashkeel – Art & Design Consultancy  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Position Level:** Senior Leadership  
**Reports to:** Director, Tashkeel  
**Salary:** AED 22,000–28,000 per month, depending on experience  
**Bonus:** Performance-based, linked to approved project gross profit and measurable creative KPIs  
**Experience:** Minimum 10 years, preferably 10–12 years or more

About Tasmeem Tashkeel

Tasmeem Tashkeel is Tashkeel's multidisciplinary art and design consultancy, specialising in bespoke commissions, furniture and product design, interior and spatial consultancy, public art, installations, corporate and VIP gifting, and exhibition conceptualisation and curation.

Working with developers, government entities, institutions, businesses and private clients, Tasmeem Tashkeel combines creative research, contemporary art and design, material exploration, craftsmanship and manufacturing expertise to deliver original, culturally informed and commercially viable projects.

Position Overview

Tashkeel is seeking an experienced and highly conceptual Head of Creative Concepts – Art & Design to lead the research, creative strategy, conceptual development and multidisciplinary design direction of Tasmeem Tashkeel's projects.

The role requires a creative leader capable of transforming client enquiries, often without a clearly defined brief, into original, cohesive and compelling creative visions. The successful candidate must connect art, furniture, lighting, products, interiors, architecture and spatial experiences through meaningful narratives supported by thorough research.

The position also leads the conceptualisation, curation and creative direction of exhibitions and showcases, including Downtown Design, NOMAD, Dubai Design Week and future national and international exhibitions.

Beyond developing concepts, the Head leads multidisciplinary teams, oversees design development, guides manufacturing teams on creative requirements and ensures approved concepts are translated into completed projects.

The position works alongside the Project Manager to streamline delivery and reports directly to the Director of Tashkeel, who retains final creative approval authority.

Key Responsibilities1. Creative Research, Strategy & Concept Development

* Lead multidisciplinary art and design projects from research and discovery through to approved creative direction.
* Interpret incomplete or open-ended client briefs, identifying opportunities and developing proposals aligned with client identity, objectives and requirements.
* Research client history, cultural context, audiences, locations, materials, artistic references and project objectives.
* Develop original narratives connecting artworks, furniture, lighting, interiors, products and spatial environments.
* Establish a clear rationale explaining why each proposed artwork, object, material or intervention suits the commission.
* Direct concept presentations, mood boards, visual references, preliminary layouts, material studies and supporting research.
* Proactively initiate furniture, lighting, product concepts and collections for Tashkeel's internal idea library, including concepts without existing client commissions.
* Identify opportunities to incorporate existing Tasmeem Tashkeel artworks, designs and collections into new commissions.

2. Multidisciplinary Art & Design Direction

Lead creative development across:

* Interior and spatial concepts for hospitality, commercial, residential and institutional environments.
* Bespoke furniture, lighting and product design.
* Public art, sculptures, murals and site-specific installations.
* Corporate and VIP gifting, including culturally informed bespoke commissions.
* Exhibition environments, trade fair stands, temporary structures and installations.
* Hospitality concepts integrating furniture, materials, artworks and spatial storytelling.
* Government and institutional art and design commissions.

Ensure all disciplines contribute to a unified creative vision rather than developing unrelated elements.

The Head must demonstrate strong conceptual and visual judgment, primarily directing specialist designers while remaining capable of producing initial sketches, concept directions and preliminary ideas when required.

3. Exhibition Conceptualisation, Curation & Spatial Design

* Lead exhibition concepts, narratives and spatial direction for Tasmeem Tashkeel's national and international showcases.
* Conceptualise stands, installations and temporary displays for Downtown Design, NOMAD, Tanween collection showcases, Dubai Design Week and other platforms.
* Curate furniture, lighting, artworks and design objects from existing collections to communicate a coherent exhibition narrative.
* Research and communicate the stories, material development, craftsmanship and creative significance behind exhibited works.
* Identify opportunities for new pieces or commissions that strengthen exhibition concepts.
* Direct interior, product and technical designers in preparing layouts, display systems, visualisations and spatial proposals.
* Review floor plans, circulation, artwork placement, lighting, sightlines, visitor experience and relationships between objects.
* Coordinate with the Project Manager and Production Leads on fabrication feasibility, venue requirements and installation constraints.
* Attend all major exhibition installations to oversee the final creative arrangement and ensure consistency with the approved concept.

The Head is accountable for exhibition creative quality, while the Project Manager and Production Leads oversee scheduling, contractors, technical execution, logistics and safety.

4. Cultural Research, Artistic Integrity & Sustainability

* Ensure creative proposals are supported by credible research and demonstrate cultural awaren
